levelRationale: Basic location words, てください directions, a simple landmark and a short walking duration. Only one turn is required, without a long sequence to memorize.

questions.explanation: The visitor repeats 左 to confirm the left turn after going straight.

options.label: Go straight and turn right at the next corner
options.rationale: The direction is left, not right.

options.label: Go straight and turn left at the next corner
options.rationale: The directions are まっすぐ行って and 次の角を左に曲がって.

options.label: Cross a bridge and turn left
Take a bus to the next stop
options.rationale: The directions are for a short walk, not a bus trip.

questions.prompt: Which route does the person describe?

questions.explanation: 郵便局 is the post office; 隣 means next to.

options.label: A bank
options.rationale: A bank is not named as the landmark.

options.label: A post office
options.rationale: The library is 郵便局の隣.

questions.prompt: What is next to the library?

questions.explanation: 歩いて specifies walking and 五分ぐらい gives an approximate five-minute duration.

options.label: 5 minutes
options.rationale: The person says 歩いて五分ぐらい.

options.label: 15 minutes
options.rationale: The answer is five minutes, not fifteen.

questions.prompt: About how long does the walk take?

title: Asking the way
topic: A person asks for directions on a street.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: すみません。図書館はどこですか。初めて来ました。道がよく分かりません。
turns.translation: Excuse me. Where is the library? This is my first visit. I don't really know the way.

turns.speaker: local
turns.text: この道をまっすぐ行って、次の角を左に曲がってください。
turns.translation: Go straight along this road, then turn left at the next corner.

turns.speaker: local
turns.text: はい、歩いて五分ぐらいです。図書館は郵便局の隣にあります。
turns.translation: Yes, about five minutes on foot. The library is next to the post office.

turns.speaker: visitor
turns.text: 分かりました。どうもありがとうございます。
turns.translation: I understand. Thank you very much.
